svg.title: Octopus - detailed editable body skin
svg.desc: Six anatomical vector groups preserving the existing silhouette. Curved color contours describe irregular papillae, pale highlight caps, ochre mottling, dark creases, and directional skin folds. No embedded bitmap images. Place at x -465.9944, y -388.9736 on the Octopus page, beneath the existing eye and suckers.
